caption: The drawing contains eight rectangular swatches arranged in two vertical columns and four horizontal rows, each featuring a different textile or wallpaper pattern. In the top-left swatch, there are black leaves and branches on a light green background. The top-right swatch displays stylized pink flowers with brown and beige leaves on a dark brown background. The second row, left swatch, shows an abstract pattern with green, brown, red, and pink forms, while the right swatch in the same row has a red and white checker pattern. The third row, left swatch, contains alternating beige and tan horizontal stripes on an off-white background with small decorative motifs in pink and beige, and the right swatch features an array of red and orange flowers, beige paisley shapes, and black background. The bottom row, left swatch, has a dark maroon background with small white and pink star-like or asterisk shapes. The bottom-right swatch presents a complex design featuring paisley and floral motifs in shades of brown, orange, beige, and white, set against a reddish-brown background. The swatches are all displayed on an off-white sheet with some visible discoloration and aging marks, especially near the lower right corner.
title: Figured Material from Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
